name: 陳仕泓
objective:
本課程旨在培養學生面對全球永續發展議題之關鍵素養與行動能力，結合理論學習與實務參與，強化其公民責任與社會關懷。課程內容以聯合國「永續發展目標」（SDGs）為核心架構，透過跨領域視角，引導學生理解生態永續、社會公平、公共關懷與公民參與之間的關聯，培養其整合多元價值與積極行動的能力。
理論面，課程介紹永續發展概念、公民參與模式及社會創新案例，培養學生問題分析與批判思考能力；實務面，則透過行動方案設計與實作，鼓勵學生走入社區或與在地組織合作，實際參與永續議題之解決，將知識轉化為具體行動。並利用「做中學」與「反思學習」，培養學生團隊合作、溝通表達及跨域整合能力，進而成為具備永續思維與實踐能力之現代公民。
This course aims to develop students’ competencies and action capabilities in addressing global sustainability issues. Integrating theory and practice, it enhances their sense of civic responsibility and social awareness. Based on the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), the course adopts an interdisciplinary approach to explore the connections among environmental sustainability, social equity, and civic engagement.
The course introduces key concepts of sustainable development, civic participation, and social innovation to strengthen students’ analytical and critical thinking skills. Through action-based projects and community engagement, students apply their knowledge to real-world sustainability challenges. Emphasizing “learning by doing” and reflective learning, the course also fosters teamwork, communication, and interdisciplinary integration, preparing students to become responsible and action-oriented global citizens.
課程進度(1-16週):
第 1 週 Week 1｜課程導論：永續發展與公民行動 Course Introduction: Sustainable Development and Civic Action
第 2 週 Week 2｜全球永續發展與 SDGs Global Sustainable Development and the SDGs
第 3 週 Week 3｜永續發展實務專題（一） Sustainable Development in Practice I
第 4 週 Week 4｜教師節放假 Teachers' Day Holiday
第 5 週 Week 5｜永續發展實務專題（二） Sustainable Development in Practice II
第 6 週 Week 6｜永續發展實務專題（三） Sustainable Development in Practice III
第 7 週 Week 7｜永續發展實務專題（四） Sustainable Development in Practice IV
第 8 週 Week 8｜光復節補假 Retroactive Holiday for Taiwan Retrocession Day
第 9 週 Week 9｜國土綠蔭氣候調適 Land Greening for Climate Adaptation
第 10 週 Week 10｜循環生活與惜食實踐 Circular Living & Food Thrift
第 11 週 Week 11｜資源循環實踐 Circular Community
第 12 週 Week 12｜循環創新與綠色職涯 Circular Innovation & Green Careers
第 13 週 Week 13｜永續議題發掘與問題分析 Identifying and Analyzing Sustainability Issues
第 14 週 Week 14｜永續行動案例探討 Exploring Sustainability Action Cases
第 15 週 Week 15｜永續行動案例探討 Exploring Sustainability Action Cases
第 16 週 Week 16｜永續行動案例設計 Designing Sustainability Action Cases
第 17 週 Week 17｜彈性學習：永續行動成果與反思 Flexible Learning: Sustainability Action Outcomes and Reflection
第 18 週 Week 18｜彈性學習：永續行動成果與反思 Flexible Learning: Sustainability Action Outcomes and Reflection
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
● 參與校內外活動 (講座、工作坊、參訪) 或競賽 (Participation in on-campus or off-campus activities (lectures, workshops, visits) or competitions)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          本課程以永續發展與 SDGs 為核心，結合行動學習。課程後期進行永續議題分析、案例探討與行動設計；第 17 至 18 週採彈性學習，引導學生參與 GEEP - APRC 國際線上研討會或實習成果發表，延伸國際交流與學習反思。
This course focuses on sustainable development and the SDGs, integrating action learning. The latter part emphasizes sustainability issue analysis, case exploration, and action design. Weeks 17–18 adopt flexible learning, guiding students to participate in GEEP - APRC international online conferences or internship presentations, extending international exchange and reflection.

          8
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          彈性學習參與及心得報告

延伸教學與資源: ● 混成學習 (Blended Learning) 課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
